name: Clean Finance
vibe: Calm UK personal-finance explainer: light-grey diagram panel on top, small white karaoke pill on the chest, one orange, Poppins everywhere.

reference.creator: Nischa (UK finance, 1M+ subs)
reference.what: top light-grey grid panel (~half the frame) that builds a diagram step by step: threshold bar, A + B = C equation, card chain; Poppins Bold titles; orange #FC8F00 as the only colour

reference.creator: Nischa (UK finance, 1M+ subs)
reference.what: white tight karaoke pill caption (grey words turn black), milestone line chart in the panel, white money number that lands on an orange block

density: One diagram panel every 8-15 s, held while she talks (3-9 s each, built step by step on the words); between panels a clean face with only the pill caption. At most one chest number per video section. No zooms, no flashes.
not: no thick black outlines, no all-caps shouting captions, no word-by-word pop
no second accent colour (green only for a 'done/restored' check)
no dark or glass cards, no gradients, no stickers/emoji, no camera shake
not Hormozi: captions are small (42 px) and quiet, not huge and bouncing

brand.note: accent is both blocks and text on white here, so the brand colour is shifted to a readable shade of the same hue

fit.good_for: 讲数据、算账、产品原理、理财和效率类讲解
fit.avoid: 纯情绪、没有可视化内容的稿子（只有观点没有数/步骤）
